name: smart-parking-mobile
description: The Android app for Smart Parking gate staff. It packages the website in ../client with Capacitor.

scripts.sync: node scripts/build-web.mjs && npx cap sync android && node scripts/harden-android.mjs && node scripts/install-native.mjs
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npx cap run android
